why_value_exists: RUN01 stopped on an ordering test that is semantically inapplicable to the released asymmetric-error columns, so it did not assess the intended summary-screening question.
All 22 frozen events passed prior identity and posterior-schema gates, all 330 summary triplets are finite and unmasked, and no candidate posterior element or response has been inspected.
A corrected, explicitly documented summary-width score can be calibrated against full posterior model distances without changing models, parameters, events or public release.

Using all 22 frozen events removes the historical predictor-stratified 8-event subsampling step, avoids selection after summary unblinding, improves precision, and eliminates event replacement discretion.
novelty_and_added_value: A release-specific reproducibility calibration of whether a cheap public-summary location/width score preserves the ordering of full posterior distribution differences across the exact alternate triad. The semantic erratum itself is independently reproducible.
not_scientific_value: It is not new evidence about GR, Kerr black holes or astrophysical populations.
It is not independent validation of waveform truth because predictor and response are computed from the same released posterior products.
It is not strict replication of B01 or the closed B07 branch.

design_choice_after_summary_unblinding.reason: All-event inclusion is the least discretionary choice after summary exposure and is stronger than selecting a predictor-dependent cohort.

principal_risks: The summary side was unblinded before this protocol, so the analysis is retrospective even though the candidate posterior outcome remains blind.
The predictor and response share posterior information, making the result a screening calibration rather than external validation.
IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor and IMRPhenomXPNR are related waveform constructions; the triad is not three fully independent model families.
The public notebook/data semantic inconsistency could affect other consumers, but this artifact can only document the released bytes, not issue an official erratum.
